fusions.name: Edict by Point
fusions.desc: Levels the haft and thrusts, dealing 32 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Sentence Passed
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Raised Standard
fusions.desc: Increases your damage reduction by 20% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Acclaim
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
